guide_game_graphics_summary: Mods not loading or rendering with broken shading? Ensure the game runs in DirectX 11 with the required graphics options.
guide_game_graphics_step1_title: 1. Launch Zenless Zone Zero in DirectX 11
guide_game_graphics_step1_desc: 3DMigoto and ZZMI only hook into DirectX 11. If the game launches in DirectX 12, mods will not load. Add "-force-d3d11" to your game launch arguments or ensure your launcher targets DirectX 11.
guide_game_graphics_step2_desc: In Options > Graphics, set Global Illumination to High. Lower settings disable lighting calculations that custom shaders rely on, causing character models to appear dark or flat.
guide_game_graphics_step3_desc: In Options > Graphics, set Character Quality to High. This forces the game engine to always render top-level LOD0 meshes that match the vertex buffers and hashes used by character mods.
guide_game_graphics_step4_desc: In Options > Graphics, turn off Character Dynamic High Precision. Leaving this setting enabled dynamically changes vertex precision during gameplay, which causes mesh jittering, stretched polygons, or broken bone weights.
guide_game_graphics_step5_desc: In Options > Graphics, turn off Volumetric Fog (Volume Fog). This prevents translucent fog passes from clipping or creating unwanted visual halos around custom hair and cloth meshes.
guide_game_graphics_step6_desc: In Options > Graphics, enable Highlight Overflow. This bloom setting ensures that glowing textures, emissive weapon effects, and neon outfit details render at full intensity.
guide_game_graphics_step7_desc: In Options > Graphics, switch Anti-Aliasing to SMAA instead of TAA. TAA frequently introduces temporal ghosting and blurriness on custom high-resolution textures and fine hair strands.
guide_game_graphics_step8_desc: In Options > Graphics, turn off Motion Blur. Disabling motion blur eliminates camera smear during fast combat actions, keeping modded outfits and weapon animations crisp.
guide_dual_variants_title: Mod Has 2+ Versions/Outfits Inside Same Folder
guide_dual_variants_summary: Downloaded a mod pack with SFW/NSFW or multiple character variants in one folder and they are glitching or overlapping?
guide_dual_variants_step1_desc: 3DMigoto automatically executes every active .ini file inside a mod folder and its subdirectories. If a mod creator puts Variant A and Variant B in subfolders without keybind switches, the game tries to load BOTH simultaneously, causing texture glitches or mesh collisions.
guide_dual_variants_step2_desc: Click the "..." (Mod Options) button on the mod card and select "Split Mod Pack". The built-in Mod Splitter will isolate each subfolder into its own standalone mod card, allowing you to toggle each version independently!
guide_dual_variants_step3_title: 3. Solution B: Disable Unused Subfolders Manually
guide_dual_variants_step3_desc: Click "Open Folder" to view the mod files in Windows Explorer. Rename any subfolder you do not want to use by prefixing it with "DISABLED " (e.g., "DISABLED Variant 2"). 3DMigoto will ignore disabled subfolders.
guide_unassigned_title: Where Did My Mod Go? (Unassigned Folder)
guide_unassigned_summary: Downloaded a UI mod, loading screen, or sound mod and cannot find it in your character list?
guide_unassigned_step1_desc: Mods without character hashes (HUD overlays, UI screens, wallpapers, audio) go into the "Unassigned" folder.
guide_unassigned_step2_desc: Open the Library tab and scroll down to the "Unassigned" folder. All UI and general mods are located there and can be enabled or disabled just like character skins.
guide_ingame_reload_title: Mods Enabled but Not Showing In-Game
guide_ingame_reload_summary: Toggled a mod on but nothing changes in Zenless Zone Zero while playing?
guide_ingame_reload_step1_desc: Zenless Zone Zero 3DMigoto mods do not require restarting the game. Whenever you enable, disable, or install a mod, press F10 on your keyboard in-game to instantly reload 3DMigoto.
guide_ingame_reload_step2_desc: Make sure your Mods folder path in Settings → General is pointing directly to your active XXMI launcher directory (typically %APPDATA%\XXMI Launcher\ZZMI\Mods).
guide_outdated_hashes_summary: Did a recent game version update cause your favorite character skin to break, stretch, or disappear?
guide_outdated_hashes_step1_desc: When HoYoverse updates the game, character 3D models are often re-compiled, changing their 8-character vertex and index buffer hashes. Mods targeting older game versions will not appear.
guide_outdated_hashes_step2_title: 2. Use Native Mod Fixer to Auto-Repair
guide_outdated_hashes_step2_desc: Click "Upgrade Outdated Mods" in the Library toolbar or the wrench button on any mod card to update hashes for the current game patch.
guide_mesh_conflicts_summary: Seeing red conflict badges on mod cards or pressing a key switches outfits on multiple characters?
guide_mesh_conflicts_step1_desc: If two enabled mods replace the same character mesh (like Ellen's body), the game will glitch. Click "View Hash Conflicts" on the mod card to see conflicting mods and disable one.
guide_mesh_conflicts_step2_desc: If two mods use the same key (e.g. key []), click "Keybinds" on the mod card or open Settings → Mod Management → Keybind Conflicts to rebind them to different keys without editing text files.
guide_gb_comments_summary: Still experiencing an unexplained bug or missing textures specific to a mod? Check the author's page or post a question.
guide_gb_comments_step1_desc: Authors usually mention required mods, keybinds, and known bugs in the mod description or pinned comments.
guide_gb_comments_step2_title: 2. Jump Straight to the Mod Page
guide_gb_comments_step2_desc: Click the globe icon or title link on any mod card in your Library (or in the Downloads history drawer) to instantly open the mod's official GameBanana page.
guide_gb_comments_step3_desc: Scroll down to the Comments section on the mod's GameBanana page. Mod authors and other players are very active and can often help solve issues with specific variants or patch updates!
troubleshoot_footer_tip: Tip: If a mod is still glitching, click the GameBanana icon on the mod card to read author notes and ask questions in the comments!

setup_desc: ZZZ Mod Manager requires XXMI Launcher to function correctly. Before we begin, you need to link your XXMI Mods folder.
setup_tip: Tip: If you use the standard XXMI Launcher installation, you can paste the exact path below into the folder browser:
library_empty_desc: To get started, click the Generate Folders button in the top bar. This will automatically set up the correct character folders.
library_loading_subtitle: Reading installed mods, verifying character entities, and indexing assets...
library_loading_hint: Taking longer than usual? Verify your Mods folder path in Settings.
library_warning_desc: Using previously created folders or manually dragging in old mods is extremely discouraged and will cause issues. We highly recommend starting fresh: generate the folders, then install your mods using the Install Mod (Archive) button or the GameBanana tab.
library_empty_tip: Once your folders are generated, try installing your first mod!
library_select_category: Select a character category from the sidebar
language_select_desc: Choose the language you'd like to use for ZZZ Mod Manager. You can always change this later in the settings.
tutorial_post_setup_desc_1: Now that your mods folder is connected, there are a few things you should know:
tutorial_post_setup_desc_2: Using previously created folders or manually dragging in old mods is extremely discouraged and may break the app. We highly recommend starting fresh: use the Generate Folders button in the Library to create empty folders, then install your mods via the app.
tutorial_post_setup_desc_3: To help you learn the ropes, keep an eye out for buttons with pulsing colored borders! Clicking these special buttons will trigger short, helpful tutorials for their features.
tutorial_post_setup_desc_4: Let's start by clicking the pulsing "Sync Cloud DB" button on the top left!
tutorial_install_mod_desc_1: Clicking Install Mod (Archive) allows you to select a `.zip`, `.rar`, or `.7z` file directly from your computer. The app will automatically extract it, determine which character it belongs to, and place it in the correct folder!
tutorial_install_mod_warning_desc: If you want to install `.rar` or `.7z` archives locally, you must first go to the Settings tab and set your WinRAR executable path (usually C:\Program Files\WinRAR\WinRAR.exe). Otherwise, only `.zip` files will work.
tutorial_launch_game_desc: This button will launch the game using the exact executable path you've provided in the Settings tab. It supports custom command-line arguments (like --nogui) so it works perfectly with the XXMI Launcher!
tutorial_discover_desc: Search and download mods directly from GameBanana without manually extracting archive files.
tutorial_achievements_desc: Welcome to the Achievements page! As you use the mod manager, installing mods, toggling them, using filters, and syncing the database, you will unlock special achievements here. Try to collect them all!
tutorial_settings_desc: Welcome to Settings! This is where you configure your critical paths (like the Mods Folder and Game Executable). You can also customize the app's look and feel, change the theme, tweak the transparency, or even set a custom background image.
tutorial_hud_desc_1: The HUD system creates a tiny, interactive menu inside your game!
tutorial_hud_desc_2: Once enabled, the app automatically tracks your active mods and generates the HUD instantly every time you toggle a mod. Press / in-game to see your keybinds.
tutorial_randomize_desc_1: Enables a random mod loadout across your selected characters.
tutorial_randomize_desc_2: You can favorite specific mods to increase their chances of being picked, or add characters to the whitelist so only they get randomized!
tutorial_sync_desc_1: By syncing the database, your app connects directly to a community-maintained list of ZZZ characters, weapons, and more.
tutorial_sync_desc_2: Updates local character data, mod categorization rules, and GameBanana mappings.
tutorial_quick_snapper_desc_1: The Quick Snapper allows you to take automatic screenshots of your currently enabled mod and automatically cycle to the next mod without alt-tabbing!
tutorial_quick_snapper_desc_2: Press <kbd className="px-2 py-1 bg-black/40 rounded border border-white/20 font-mono text-xs">Alt+Shift+S</kbd> while in-game. The app will snap a screenshot, crop it to the values you set in Settings, and automatically move on to the next mod.
tutorial_quick_snapper_warning_desc: If this global shortcut does not work, it means another program on your system (like GeForce Experience, Discord, or AMD Adrenalin) is already using Alt+Shift+S. You will need to disable or change it in that other program for this to work.
tutorial_generate_folders_desc_2: To get started with adding mods, you first need to setup your base folders. Click the Generate Folders button in the Library top bar.
tutorial_generate_folders_desc_3: Creates character and skin folders in your XXMI Mods directory based on the database.

rule_rogue_hud_desc: Detects scripts that continuously clear in-game menu text ('Help = null') during rendering, hiding other mods' menus.
rule_standalone_help_desc: Detects bundled legacy help.ini files inside mod folders that conflict with ZZMI's global HUD.
rule_multi_character_desc: Identifies mods containing texture/model hashes belonging to multiple different characters.
rule_unconditional_key_desc: Detects hotkeys missing an active character check ('condition = $active == 1'), causing toggles to trigger across all characters.
rule_conflict_desc: Detects when two active mods attempt to replace the exact same texture or mesh hash.
rule_missing_vertex_limit_override_desc: Detects incomplete VertexLimitRaise sections that cause vertex buffer overflow and exploding polygons.
rule_missing_resource_definition_desc: Detects undefined buffer resources that trigger immediate DirectX crashes to desktop.
rule_duplicate_section_desc: Detects duplicate section headers in INI files which trigger 3DMigoto runtime parser errors.
rule_missing_resource_ref_desc: Detects ZZMI texture and buffer slot assignments missing the 'ref' keyword (e.g. 'Resource\ZZMI\... = Resource...').
rule_unconditional_texture_override_desc: Detects texture re-assignments after draw calls outside conditional blocks that cause texture flickering and Z-fighting.
rule_outdated_version_desc: Warns when mod hashes target older game patches (1.0 - 1.4) that need remapping.

feat_hash_sort_desc: Automatically routes installed archives to the correct character or skin folder using 3DMigoto vertex and index buffer hash matching with Shared Hash Subtraction scoring.
feat_drag_drop_desc: Drag and drop .zip, .rar, or .7z mod archives anywhere onto the application window to initiate instant installation and auto-sorting.
feat_fast_toggle_desc: Renames mod folders with or without the DISABLED prefix so 3DMigoto loads or ignores them.
feat_batch_ops_desc: Multi-select mode allowing bulk management across categories to bulk-enable, bulk-disable, move to a destination, or delete.
feat_global_search_desc: Universal search across all character categories, skins, and mod names, flattening collections into a single instant-filtered grid.
feat_mod_profiles_desc: Create, save, switch, and share loadout presets for active mods per category with 1-click switching and JSON clipboard export/import.
feat_mod_notes_desc: Attach custom notes, tags, and attribution metadata to any mod without altering mod INI files, safely persisted in .zmm-meta.json.
feat_mod_tags_desc: Interactive tag badges (#Outfit, #Recolor, #NSFW, #Weapon, #Audio) with multi-tag filtering, fuzzy autocomplete deduplication, and GameBanana tag sync.
feat_keybinds_desc: Inspect and edit mod keybinds from the UI, with warnings for overlapping shortcuts.
feat_broken_scanner_desc: Identifies mods rendered unusable by game updates with Tier 1 (Confirmed Outdated via migrations) and Tier 2 (Unverified) diagnostic alerts.
feat_script_warnings_desc: Detects mod script bugs including rogue HUD erasers, legacy help.ini files, multi-character overlaps, and unconditional hotkeys with 1-click auto-repair.
feat_hash_conflict_desc: Detects when two simultaneously enabled mods override the exact same texture or mesh component, translating raw hashes into readable names.
feat_hunting_mode_desc: Sniffs and captures runtime vertex and index buffer hashes from d3dx.log during gameplay, cross-referencing against database definitions for easy ingestion.
feat_gb_discover_desc: In-app browser to explore, search, and filter thousands of mods directly from the GameBanana v13 API with screenshots, tags, and rich descriptions.
feat_gb_download_desc: Asynchronous download manager with real-time speed, ETA calculation, and Tokio retry loops with backoff to gracefully handle connection timeouts.
feat_update_checker_desc: Compares installed mod timestamps with GameBanana API endpoints to detect and alert when newer mod versions are released.
feat_hud_desc: Dynamically generates an interactive 3DMigoto in-game menu (zzzzzz_ZZZModManagerUI) showing active mods and assigned keybinds accessible by pressing your configured hotkey in-game.
feat_snapper_desc: Global OS hotkey capture tool that photographs your currently enabled mod in-game, crops the viewport, saves preview.png, and advances to the next mod.
feat_hotreload_desc: Automatically focuses ZZZ and dispatches the 3DMigoto F10 reload key when mod states change while the game is running.
feat_launcher_desc: Launches Zenless Zone Zero directly through the XXMI Launcher with support for custom command-line arguments (e.g. --nogui).
feat_splitter_desc: Decompiles composite multi-character mod packages into clean, independent single-character mod folders with preserved shader and texture dependencies.
feat_randomizer_desc: Automatically selects and enables random mod loadouts across whitelisted character categories with favorite weightings.
feat_cropper_desc: Interactive canvas-based pan, zoom, and aspect-ratio locked image cropper (1:1, 16:9, 3:4, Free) with 90-degree rotation for crisp preview cards.
feat_themes_desc: Customize app theme colors, custom HEX accent color, custom background wallpapers with brightness/blur controls, UI scaling, and card sizes.
feat_language_hub_desc: Full internationalization suite with a visual in-app translation editor, live key editing, and .json language pack import/export.
feat_storage_desc: Hardened localStorage wrapper preventing crashes from corrupted data, paired with automated schema migrations across releases.
feat_backup_desc: 1-click export and import of all configured paths, custom themes, hotkeys, warning rules, and mod profiles into a portable .json backup file.
feat_watcher_desc: Watches the active XXMI Mods folder for external additions, deletions, or renames and automatically refreshes library state without polling.
feat_auto_tagger_desc: 100% offline asset classification (#Outfit, #Recolor, #Audio, #Weapon, #UI) by analyzing mod file structures, textures, meshes, and audio containers.
feat_char_filters_desc: Filter character categories by combat Element (Electric, Fire, Ice, Physical, Ether), in-game Faction, Gender, and Model Archetype.
feat_cat_mapping_desc: Category descriptor sidecars (category.json) with manual mapping modal linking custom disk folders directly to database entities.
feat_folder_gen_desc: 1-click generation of organized disk directory trees for all playable characters and skins directly matching the central cloud database schema.
feat_unassigned_sort_desc: 1-click batch analysis that scans unclassified archives in the Unassigned/ folder and re-sorts them to matching character folders using hash detection.
feat_install_summary_desc: Detailed post-extraction inspection modal reporting detected character categories, hash matching confidence scores, and conflict alerts.
feat_mindscape_desc: Shows official Mindscape character art in the background of character mod lists.
feat_achievements_desc: Gamified progression system with 25+ unlockable achievements, live real-time progress bars, expandable step guides, and celebration confetti.
feat_tutorials_desc: First-run setup assistant and modal tutorial guides with pulsing colored button borders guiding users through folder setup and key features.
feat_notifications_desc: In-app notification center querying remote notifications.json for new version release announcements, patch notes, and community alerts.
feat_signed_updater_desc: Checks GitHub for new releases, verifies file signatures with Minisign, and updates the app.

card_darkening_gradient_desc: Smooth bottom shadow to enhance readability of buttons and text.
card_hover_zoom_desc: Slightly enlarge mod thumbnail when hovered with the mouse.
card_show_folder_btn_desc: Directly open the mod folder in Windows Explorer.
card_show_3d_btn_desc: Launch the embedded 3D viewer for 3DMigoto meshes.
card_show_options_btn_desc: Context actions: rename, move, repair, backup, and delete.
card_show_favorite_badge_desc: Quick toggle to add or remove mod from favorites.
card_show_size_badge_desc: Shows disk size in MB/GB on the upper right.
card_show_update_badge_desc: Alerts when newer mod files are available on GameBanana.
card_show_subtitle_desc: Displays the character name or category under the mod title.
card_show_tags_desc: Renders clickable tag chips (#outfit, #nsfw, etc.) inside the card.
card_toggle_locked_desc: The enable/disable action button cannot be hidden. This ensures that mods can always be toggled directly from the card.
card_toggle_glow_desc: Soft colored drop-shadow when the mod is enabled.
library_tools_desc: Quick access to folder setup, updates, health analysis, and engine settings.
card_show_lock_badge_desc: Toggle on the upper left to include or lock out mod from Randomizer.
card_show_warning_badges_desc: Displays rollback, upgrade, and conflict status pills on the upper right.
